sources.fullCitation: Orkiestra teatru „Perskie Oko”, conducted by Zygmunt Wiehler. “A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni.” Shimmy. Syrena Grand Record no. 17921, matrix 17921, 1926. The transfer is published by Stare Melodie from a disc lent by a private collector; its description credits the music to Henryk Chwast under the pseudonym Bruno Asper, where the sheet music of 1926 carries only the pseudonym. Accessed 20 August 2026.
